messages:
Alice: heads up — deploybot flagged canary for runtime v2.13.1 in eu-west-1, automatic hold engaged :warning:
DeployBot: Canary rollout halted at 3:14 UTC. 4/20 canary hosts failed healthcheck (OOM on kv-cache). Rolling to HOLD state. Notifying oncall and support channels.
sre-jen: acked. grabbing logs now — likely batch sizing regression with new kernel shim.
Alice: thanks. we need a short customer-facing status update (statuspage + a targeted note for enterprise customers). Can someone draft?
support-liz: I can draft a statuspage snippet. Do we want an advisory or a degraded-service message?
Alice: degraded tokens/latency for affected region, but not total outage. customers on Dedicated may see failures if pinned to v2.13.1 — recommend temporary version hold for those customers.
product-omar: we should offer a rollback path and a pinned-variant to enterprise customers (v2.12.9-stable). Also suggest ways to mitigate (reduce batching to 1-2).
sre-jen: confirmed reproducible with large sequence loads + continuous-batching enabled. Hotfix ETA ~2h if we isolate kernel path, rollback ETA ~20m for canary -> full rollback.
support-liz: OK drafting two snippets: short statuspage blurb + email template for enterprise. Paste for review:

Statuspage snippet (short):
```
Summary: Canary for runtime v2.13.1 in eu-west-1 was paused after we detected elevated memory errors impacting a subset of requests. Impact: increased latency and occasional request failures for some customers in eu-west-1.
Current status: Canary paused; mitigation and rollback options being evaluated.
Next update: in ~30 minutes or on resolution.
```

Enterprise email snippet (personalized):
```
Hi {{customer_name}},
We detected a regression in our recent runtime update (v2.13.1) that may affect inference latency and reliability for some workloads in eu-west-1.
Action: We have paused the canary and are offering to hold your services on the previous stable runtime (v2.12.9-stable) while we investigate. If you'd like us to pin your Dedicated capacity or non-shared runtime to the stable variant, reply to this message and we'll schedule the hold immediately.
Expected timeline: rollback available within ~20 minutes; deeper fix ETA 2 hours.
We apologize for the disruption and will follow up with updates.
Best,
Support — Redwood Inference
```

Alice: nice. Add a sentence about mitigation CLI flag for self-serve customers?
support-liz: added: "CLI: `redwood runtime set-variant --region eu-west-1 --variant v2.12.9-stable` or contact support."
product-omar: also add note about customers using long sequence prompts to temporarily lower batch sizes. Quick command: `redwood runtime config --batch-size 1`
sre-jen: sharing a quick troubleshooting snippet for ops folks:
```
# Check OOM traces on canary host
sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200 | grep -i oom
# Temporarily disable continuous batching
redwoodctl set-config --service runtime --key continuous_batching --value false --region eu-west-1
```

ops-bot: Requested: create incident record and page update. Incident# INC-2028 created.
Alice: Support — please queue the enterprise email for customers with Dedicated in eu-west-1 (high-touch list). Use intercom tag: dedicated-eu-west1-impact.
support-liz: on it. I’ll send a targeted batch within 10 minutes and post the statuspage update now.
Alice: Engineering — hold on full rollout until we get a green canary or explicit rollback decision. If rollback, state the rollback time and notify customers.
sre-jen: agreed. If we can reproduce and confirm kernel path patch fixes mem spike, we’ll re-canary the patch. Otherwise we roll back v2.13.1 cluster-wide. I’ll post an ETA update in 30m.
product-omar: small ask — include a release-note line in upcoming changelog explaining the regression and a reference to the rollback option.
Alice: good call. Support & SRE, update the incident timeline when you send the email/status update.
support-liz: statuspage updated and enterprise batch queued (tags attached). Will paste the sent email copy here when delivered.
DeployBot: Canary hold cleared to manual only. No automatic progression will occur until manual resume.
Alice: thanks team. leaving this thread open for updates — please post the sent email and any rollback actions here. :thumbsup:
